description: A nursing supervisor must decide whether to activate an overnight bedside hemodialysis session for a patient on Unit 4 and finalize the timing and qualified-nurse coverage, with input from the nephrology coordinator and the staffing office coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The overnight team is considering a hemodialysis session for a patient in Unit 4.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the final decision about whether the bedside session will be activated and records the operating plan.
shared_context.S3: The dialysis machine and routine supplies are available for an overnight session.
shared_context.S4: Before the plan is finalized, Maya conducts the standard evening huddle with nephrology and staffing to review clinical and coverage requirements.

PF1.text: Nephrology's current order requires the patient to receive dialysis at the bedside tonight beginning at exactly 22:00 because transport to the dialysis unit is not permitted during the ordered treatment window; Dr. Chen confirmed the order in the nephrology work queue, but the nursing plan has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: The only qualified dialysis RN available for this session is assigned to Unit 4 from exactly 21:30 through 02:00; Luis confirmed the assignment in the staffing roster, but the coverage window has not been entered into the bedside dialysis plan.

acceptance_conditions: The bedside dialysis session must be approved.
The dialysis location must be recorded as Unit 4 bedside.
The session must be scheduled to begin at exactly 22:00.
Qualified dialysis RN coverage must be recorded from exactly 21:30 through 02:00.
The nephrology order requiring bedside dialysis at 22:00 must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'bedside_dialysis_activation' and c['target'] == 'Unit 4' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The nephrology order changes the plan from an unspecified or potentially deferred session to an approved Unit 4 bedside session beginning exactly at 22:00 and requires the activation commitment.

The staffing roster changes the coverage plan from unspecified availability to qualified dialysis RN coverage beginning at exactly 21:30 and ending at exactly 02:00, which makes the overnight session operationally supportable.
